name: skans-question-bank
description: SKANS School of Accountancy - Question Bank & Exam Paper Generator (prototype)

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm run db:setup -w server && npm run browsers -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
